explanation: Ozymandias was a Greek name for the pharaoh Ramesses II. Shelley wrote it in a friendly sonnet-writing contest with Horace Smith, who published his own poem on the same subject.

Shelley wrote Ozymandias in a friendly sonnet-writing contest with Horace Smith, who published his own poem on the same subject.
